insight.title: Birds Navigate Continents With Invisible Maps
insight.subtitle: Their annual journeys reveal an inherited sense for Earth's hidden fields and stellar guides.

sections.text: Each year, billions of birds embark on epic migrations, navigating thousands of miles across oceans and landmasses with pinpoint accuracy.
They sense Earth's magnetic field like an internal compass, calibrating it with the sun's position and the patterns of night stars.
This complex, multi-sensory system allows precise, decentralized navigation, ensuring entire populations find distant, seasonal homes without a single leader.
The planet is their silent, guiding chart.
